company.name: Payload
company.shortDescription: Payload CMS is a headless CMS and application framework designed to improve collaboration among developers, marketers, and product owners.
company.description:
Payload CMS is a self-hosted, headless TypeScript CMS created with Node, React, and MongoDB. The platform secures data by implementing access control functions at the document or field level. Its field types are far more robust than any other headless CMS available. Dynamic fields such as Arrays and Blocks unleash incredible power, while purpose-built fields such as Relationship and GeoJSON enable extremely flexible data modeling.

Payload was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Michigan.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $322,500, representing 5.84% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,348,211 to $20,268,215, a 3.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
